properties.name: D3 settled: Anthony tells the MCP users of a deprecation before the release ships, and the cut waits for his word
properties.rationale:
Anthony, 2026-10-14: "Merge 752 and go with your recommendation on D3". The rule this serves (req:the-mcp-server-keeps-working-as-is-and-door-improvements-are-additive-or-opt-in, amended 2026-10-13) exists so that Alex is never surprised. The in-band notice from #751 reaches a client only when it calls the deprecated item, so a person has to tell him. The first release this applies to is the one carrying #752, the Anchor deprecation.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Step 2 of the release cut no longer leaves "who tells Alex, and how" open. The cutting agent drafts a short note from the release's Deprecated and Removed entries and their What to do lines. Anthony sends it; the agent never does, and puts it in his Gmail as a draft only on his request. The release is not tagged until he says he has told Alex. Written into AGENTS.md (the flow:release-cut bullet), deprecation.rs's module note and cap:a-cuts-release-notes-say-what-is-going-and-what-has-gone, which is now GOVERNED_BY the new decision.
